en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a small harbor scene. In the foreground are sacks piled along a stone quay, with several people standing and walking nearby. A long, low waterfront building with open arches stands beside calm water where a boat is moored. Hills rise in the background. The card is heavily written over in ink, including a schedule of ports and dates. Printed captions include the place name and other labels.
